name: The Reisen
teaser: A Moon Rabbit with a gun. What more do you need? Adds in the Touhou Project Character Reisen Undongein Inaba as a Playable character in SPT.
description_html:
Hello everyone! This mod is a model of a Touhou character called Reisen Undongein Inaba. You can play as her in raid and her character shows in the menu and in raid.

You install by placing the folder into your user/mods folder. This version of Reisen has her eyes non-glowing which I will release in another version of the mod (that will have to get its own mod page as well.)

How do you get the character to show or use her?

HOW TO USE CHARACTER: You create a profile in SPT, load into said profile on startup, select a character as you would normally etc then quit and close the server and launcher. then you go to your user folder, go to profiles, and select the preferred or only profile you use; Open up the JSON file with Notepad or Notepad ++ if you have them or whatever text app you use, IMPORTANT: SCROLL DOWN UNTIL YOU SEE A LINE MARKED CUSTOMIZATION IN YOUR PROFILE. Then delete the ID’s there those are of the character you selected in character creation. Replace the now empty space with THESE LINES:

“Body”: “683e7fa72afc6f3c4c0927b9”

“Feet”: “683e7fa72afc6f3c4c0927b8”,

“Hands”: “683e7fa72afc6f3c4c0927b6”,

“Head”: “683e7fa72afc6f3c4c0927b7”

These must be exactly like this because they are MongoID’s and do not delete ANYTHING else besides this portion or the brackets or you will be confused as to why it doesn’t work.

if installed and done correctly, you will now have the character. it should show up in the menu screen and hideout and in the raid. You can use the Freecam mod for 3.11 to confirm the model works.

NOTES AND ISSUES: The character Reisen can use all weapons with little issue. There is likely to be clipping on some weapons tho this is mainly to be likely on modded weapons and not base ones but it is still possible. There is also clipping with backpacks and the hair and sadly cannot fix that but it’s not an issue unless you love 3rd person. The model also has a skirt that has physics which can be an issue going prone if you not a fan of viewing backsides but this only occurs if you move too fast or frequently so no issue. (3rd person persons) Sadly her mouth is stuck in a sort of O shape where she’s stunned and I’ve had trouble trying to change this without screwing something up. so I have to leave it there sadly. Her arms and hands are also massive which is an issue of porting over Anime characters into Tarkov due to how Skeletons and Unity works etc You also cannot select her from character creation as a head. You must follow the method above.

Note: If you are using multiple skin mods, use Skin Service instead of the instructions above to avoid any potential errors.

UPDATE: SHE CAN WEAR ALL TRADER CLOTHING INCLUDING MODDED ONES. Her head will work with them. Try to use ones that don’t have hands like the PCU Ironsight or Sandstone or Cercum etc. Update: She can wear clothing from any mod but would recommend non-hand-showing or non arm showing clothes. She can also wear armor and rigs from other mods.

You will have to change her clothes in user/profiles to get her blazer and skirt back if you change her outfit via any trader’s services.

But otherwise, I hope I’ve answered all your questions here. I apologize for the long description but this needed to be specific and detailed so people do not have fuckups or ask the same questions all over the place. NOTE: if you ask for help without reading at least the installation part, you will be ignored.

Note: You will sometimes see a bug where the character goes black, and all her models do the same. This is because of the MMD outline and doesn’t affect gameplay. It’s an old bug. Edit: This can be confused with EFT lighting, too, so be aware.

Completely forgot, the OG model ie the one used is by Miku555 from Devianart. https://www.deviantart.com/miku555/art/my-reisen-inaba-mmd-model-278624958

Updated to SPT 3.11 Pls let me know of any issues with the mod in the comments or in SPT Discord.

If you use a bot progression mod like ALP, the character will show up as a PMC you fight in raids. It’s recommended you play at night and with glowing eyes version for max immersion or just to be scared. This doesn’t happen with Valen’s. (This version isn’t available for 3.11 as of yet. ignore this part for now.)

This Mod should be able to work with Project FIKA or FIKA. I haven’t tested it but feel free to try it out if interested.

Enjoy!
